title: Constitutional evolution: 1773 to 1935
quote: Control shifted from Company to London step by step; the 1919 and 1935 Acts redefined legislative power until 1947

items.what: **Regulating Act**: ==first parliamentary control== of EIC; **Warren Hastings** GG of Bengal; **4-member** council; Supreme Court Calcutta (**1774**, CJ **Elijah Impey**)
**Pitt's India Act**: ==**dual control**== - **Board of Control** (political) + **Court of Directors** (commercial); council cut to **3**
GG can **override council** + act as C-in-C: **Cornwallis**
Charter: monopoly extended **20 years**; GG's grip on Bombay, Madras tightened
Monopoly ended ==except **tea** + **China** trade==; **missionaries** allowed; **₹1 lakh** for education
==GG of **India**: **Bentinck**==; **Macaulay** Law Member; trade ended fully; **Section 87**: no discrimination
Legislative + executive functions separated; **open competition** (Macaulay Committee **1854**); **6** legislative members; last Charter Act

boxes.title: Crown rule: 1858 and 1861
items: Board of Control + Court of Directors **abolished**; **Secretary of State** + **15-member** Council of India
**1861**: Indians **nominated** (Raja of Benaras, Maharaja of Patiala, Dinkar Rao)
**Portfolio system** (⚠ other notes: Canning **1859**, statutory in 1861)
==Viceroy's **ordinance** power (**6 months**)==; Bombay, Madras powers restored

boxes.title: 1892 vs 1909
head: Feature
1909 (Morley-Minto)
rows: **S.P. Sinha**: first Indian in Viceroy's EC (Law Member); centre **60** additional, unicameral

boxes.title: GoI Act 1919 (Montagu-Chelmsford)
items: Montagu declaration **20 August 1917**: gradual responsible government
==**Dyarchy in provinces**==: reserved (Governor + EC) vs transferred (Governor + Ministers)
**Bicameral** Centre: Council of State + Legislative Assembly; **direct elections**
**Chamber of Princes** (**120**; Ganga Singh of Bikaner); High Commissioner in London

cards.title: Provinces
lines: Bicameral in **6**: Bengal, Bombay, Madras, Bihar, Assam, UP

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Trap: "Regulating Act abolished Court of Directors" = **incorrect** (APPSC-GS 2019)
UPSC 2024: Federation correct; Defence + Foreign under federal legislature = wrong (reserved under **GG**)
Act of **1767**: **£400,000** a year (APPSC-G2 2017); Board of Control = Pitt's (UPPSC 2015)
